rows.claim: A selection that names a selector and keeps nothing is the warning `EmptyFaceSelection`.
rows.evidence: probe:76 (`input_passthrough(host, "c"; only = ())` returns both faces, no warning); src/assembly.jl:546 (`only::Tuple = ()` default), src/assembly.jl:617 (`isempty(only_faces) ||` treats an explicit empty `only` as not given), src/assembly.jl:627
rows.fix: Default `except` and `only` to `nothing` in input_passthrough and output_passthrough, so an explicit `only = ()` counts as a given selector, keeps no face and warns `EmptyFaceSelection`.
rows.note: Edge case: with `except` or `select` the warning fires (probe:68). An explicit `only = ()`, such as a computed list that came out empty, cannot be told from the default, so every face passes through silently. The code comment at src/assembly.jl:633-635 assumes `only` never keeps nothing.

notes:
Read-only slice. I edited no tracked file. The probe is design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/L8b/probe.jl in the main checkout, and I ran it against W at 72b12836. On W, check_refs.jl passes: every D-nnn and § citation in the 22 Positions resolves. All 22 entries have Status ratified, and none carries a superseded → chain. The cross-references that do supersede (D-469 → D-185/D-283/D-459/D-457, D-472 amending D-184/D-313) resolve to ratified entries. D-436, which I cite in rows 091 and 098, is superseded → D-437, and D-437 is ratified.

Findings. Of 14 rows, 11 are drift and 9 of those are already annotated in the log: 040, 041, 045 (D-254), 083, 088, 107, 118. Two drifts are unannotated: 050 (Schedule vectors, D-261) and 091/098 (Junction's `out` port, D-436/D-437). Row 017 (`output_types`, D-267) is a rename with no annotation; log rule 2 keeps it, so a verifier may rule it ok. There is one possible defect: 035, where an explicit `only = ()` in input_/output_passthrough passes every face through silently. There is one wording deviation: 070, the misplaced-pin hint quotes `F` but the code says "this leaf". One row is unverifiable: 023, because "instance walk" names no code path.

Leads. `Mixed` and `inN` are placeholders (ok 057, 090). `Not` and `exports` are rejected or retired names (ok 096, 087). `add!` and `Assembly` belong to the rejected builder (ok 077; the test `Assembly` is a fixture type at test/fixtures.jl:1835). `output_types` is row 017, `N_base` is row 041, and `u_connections`/`y_connections` are row 088.

A side observation outside the claims: `input_wires(::Named) = 5` is refused as `:not_a_pair` rather than `:not_a_collection`, because an Int iterates in Julia. D-477 names only the kind, so I did not list it.
